question: T. Balasaraswati is related to which of the following dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatnatyam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• T. Balasaraswati was one of the most renowned exponents of **Bharatnatyam**, a classical dance form from Tamil Nadu, India.
 
• She was instrumental in popularizing Bharatnatyam globally and was known for her expressive abhinaya (the art of expression in Indian classical dance).
 
• T. Balasaraswati received several prestigious awards, including the Padma Bhushan and the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award, for her contributions to the art form.
 
• Her performances were highly acclaimed for their depth, emotional intensity, and technical precision.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharatnatyam:**

 
 
• Bharatnatyam is one of the oldest classical dance forms in India, originating from Tamil Nadu.
 
• It is known for its fixed upper torso, bent legs, and intricate footwork combined with expressive hand gestures and facial expressions.
 
• The dance form is traditionally performed by women and has its roots in the temples of Tamil Nadu.
 
• It comprises three main elements: Nritta (pure dance), Nritya (expressive dance), and Natya (dramatic dance).
 
 
 
• **Kathak:**
 
 
• Kathak is a classical dance form from Northern India, characterized by intricate footwork, spins, and expressive storytelling.
 
• The word 'Kathak' is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Katha,' meaning story, and the dance form traditionally involves the narration of stories from epics and mythology.
 
 
 
• **Odissi:**
 
 
• Odissi is a classical dance form from Odisha, known for its fluid movements, sculpturesque poses, and expressive facial expressions.
 
• It has a strong connection with the temples of Odisha and often depicts stories of Lord Jagannath.
 
 
 
• **Kathakali:**
 
 
• Kathakali is a classical dance-drama from Kerala, known for its elaborate costumes, detailed makeup, and face masks.
 
• It combines dance, drama, and music to depict tales from Hindu epics like the Mahabharata and Ramayana.
